options.name: age
options.description: Select objects whose age is equal to or greater than the specified time. Use a negative age to find objects equal to or less than the specified time. You can choose seconds, minutes, hours, days, or weeks by specifying the first letter of any of those \n words (e.g., "1w").

options.name: age_stamp
options.description: Choose the object statistic against which we compare age. Default is ctime which is the object creation time.

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: iasp_name
options.description: The auxiliary storage pool (ASP) where storage is allocated for the object. The default value is C(*SYSBAS). If an IASP name is specified, objects in this ASP group will be returned, including both SYSBAS and IASP.

options.name: joblog
options.description: The job log of the job executing the task will be returned even rc is zero if it is set to true.

options.name: lib_name
options.description: The name of the library that returned objects locate in

options.name: object_name
options.description: The name of the object that will be returned. Whether regex can be used for object_name is controlled by C(use_regex) option

options.name: object_type_list
options.description: One or more system object types separated by either a blank or a comma.

options.name: size
options.description: Select objects whose size is equal to or greater than the specified size. Use a negative size to find objects equal to or less than the specified size. Unqualified values are in bytes but b, k, m, g, and t can be appended to specify bytes, kilobytes, megabytes, gigabytes, and terabytes, respectively.

options.name: use_regex
options.description: Controls whether regex can be used for object_name option. The target IBM i system needs to have the International Components for Unicode (ICU) option installed. It takes time to return result if this option is turned on.
